pairs.difference: A (jacket): an even dark contour runs around the collar, sleeves and hem. Every pocket flap, sash edge and badge rim has an equally strong line, and subject density of 0.159 sits just above the real top. B (hat): the silhouette is thin and breaks away at the crown's left shoulder and under the brim. Only the band and star carry sharp edges, as on the real cards.
pairs.fix: Let the jacket's outer edge fade where light wraps it, and keep the sharpest edges only on the badges. Make pocket and sash seams thin and faint, with no even dark rim around the shape.

pairs.difference: B (photo print): the background rays are wide and fuzzy in the edge map, whereas real backgrounds have thin clean band lines. The photo frame is a heavy ruler-straight black line, and the speakers and truss are mushy. The signature sits in a mottled patch. A (neck pillow): the concentric rings are clean and thin, but the inner loop is very dark and the pleats are noisy.
pairs.fix: Draw the background rays as clean, sharp-edged bands. Give the print a thin paper edge with slight bevel, remove the heavy frame line, and keep the white margin free of mottling around the signature.

pairs.difference: A (bracelet): fine contour, with the far rim losing its edge against the blue, and crisp raised music icons as the focus. B (star badge): clean double bevel lines along the gold rim and soft balls at the tips. Both have thin, controlled edges and clean background pattern lines, within the real range.

B (saloon): dark, even lines box every window, roof rib and railing, and the porch boards are ruled with the same weight, so nothing leads. Outline value of -0.059 is just outside the real range. A (dock): the rope carries the sharp edges, while the ring, water and sand soften and fade, giving a clear edge hierarchy.
pairs.fix: Keep the sharpest edges on the swing doors. Make wall boards and roof ribs thin, faint seams, and let the side wall and far windows soften, with no dark line around each part.

pairs.difference: B (beach ball): the seams are thick dark curves that swell and thin unevenly, and the sand is a scatter of speckle dots and smeared swirls in the edge map. Background density of 0.003 and subject density of 0.029 are both below the real range. A (saddle): thin precise stitch and panel lines, crisp buckle as the focus, clean wavy background lines.
pairs.fix: Draw the ball's panel joins as thin, even, precise seams. Make the sand a smooth soft surface without scattered grain dots or smeared ripples.

pairs.difference: A (ice tray): frost along the rims and bases breaks into a dense crust of tiny broken edges. Table plank gaps are thick black grooves, stronger than the hero's own edges. B (coffee pot): smooth body with a thin contour that softens on the lit side, and sharp lines only at the rivets, lid rim and log ends.
pairs.fix: Replace the frost crust with a few simple soft white patches. Make table plank gaps thin and faint, and keep the sharpest edges on the top ice cube.

pairs.difference: B (sneakers): a heavy contour wraps both shoes and the sole layers, with dense lace and mesh lines, and a ruled black horizon crosses the card. Outline of -0.1 is outside the real range. A (lasso): dense rope twist lines but a light contour, and the loop and rail edges vary in strength.
pairs.fix: Soften the wall-to-floor line into a gentle tone change. Remove the heavy rim around the shoes, keep the crisp edges at the laces, and let the far shoe's edges soften.

pairs.difference: B (vending machine): the window frame is a thick double black line, stronger than the body silhouette. Inside it, droplets become speckle and the cans and bottles turn mushy. Outline of 0.088 is near the real top. A (cactus): the contour is rather even and dark and the spines blot, but internal ribs stay thin.
pairs.fix: Thin the window frame to a fine bevel. Remove the droplet speckle from the glass, and give the cans and bottles clean, simple edges.

pairs.difference: A (boot): a solid dark contour runs along the sole, toe and shaft. The toe and heel fill with stippled grain edges, and the flame panels are lined at full strength. B (graduation cap): thin crisp bevel lines on the board, with soft edges and lost lines along the crown and band, leaving very few internal edges.
pairs.fix: Make the leather smooth with no grain speckle. Keep sharp edges on the spur, let the sole and shaft edges fade softly, and draw the flame panels as thin seams.

pairs.difference: B (map): every sheet has the same hard, dark, even line, and the folded lower sheets repeat it. Outline of -0.137 is well outside the real range, and background density of 0.008 is below it. A (bottle): glass edges vary and fade into the water, with sharp accents at the cork, scroll end and bubbles. Its low subject density comes from soft glass.
pairs.fix: Give the paper sheets thin soft edges with a slight rounded thickness. Let lower sheets fade slightly, and keep the sharpest edges on the red X.

pairs.difference: B (locomotive): heavy dark contours run around the boiler, cab, wheels and rails with almost no fall-off. Subject density of 0.266 is at the real top, and outline of -0.071 is outside the real range. A (bus): a light, more varied contour with glass and body edges softening, though the road at lower left breaks into speckle.
pairs.fix: Reduce the line weight on the boiler and cab, leaving thin panel seams. Keep sharp edges on the wheels and headlamp, and let the rails and distant rocks soften.

pairs.difference: B (fountain): pavers are thick dark grooves with broken, cracked lines, competing with the hero. The wall stripes show dotted noise, the water edges tangle, and background density of 0.046 is at the real top. A (wagon): a strong contour on the canvas top, but the wall stripes and ground are clean and quiet, and the wheels hold the sharp edges.
pairs.fix: Make paver joints thin, faint and continuous, fading toward the card edges. Keep the wall stripes clean, and draw the falling water with a few smooth edges.

pattern: Generated cards still give themselves away through even edge strength. A dark, unbroken contour wraps the hero, and internal seams match it in weight. Real cards let edges fade and get lost, keeping the sharpest ones at the focus. Generated cards also put noise where real ones stay quiet: speckled sand, frost, grain and droplets, thick grooves in floors and tables, and fuzzy or ruled background lines instead of thin clean bands.
